description: This PHP source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'LeaveSearchFilterParams' used for filtering leave search results within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes properties and methods specific to leave request filtering.

classes.name: LeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class for specifying search filters related to leave requests, including sorting by 'leave.date' and filtering by leave request ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'leave.date'.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the leave request ID filter value, which can be an integer or null.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID filter value.
